subject: Archaeology
title: AI Reading Ancient Texts
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: AI Reading Ancient Texts.

hook.text: A machine-learning model trained on Greek can fill in missing text on broken inscriptions.

buildup.text: DeepMind's Ithaca model was trained on 78,000 ancient Greek inscriptions to predict gaps.

discovery.text: Ithaca scored 62 percent accuracy. Human experts alone managed just 25 percent.

twist.text: AI does not replace scholars. When humans used Ithaca's tips, accuracy jumped to 72 percent.

climax.text: Similar AI is now being trained for cuneiform and Egyptian hieratic. Millions of texts await.

punchline.text: A computer reads broken Greek better than experts. Together they read best.

quiz.question: How does AI help with ancient inscription analysis?
options: It replaces human scholars entirely with automated translations
It predicts missing text, and when combined with humans, boosts accuracy to 72%
It photographs inscriptions and uploads them for crowdsourcing
